hook.say: This morning: Google put Gemini 4 into Search to answer complex questions, with more visual answers and a wider range of links. I went back in to check the numbers.

findings.label: CITATIONS
findings.headline: Sources cited per run in AI Mode, the most of Google's three
findings.detail: Profound data from May 2026, across 2.64 billion citations in AI Mode, AI Overviews and the Gemini app.
findings.evidence: AI Mode cites most at 15.2 per run, AI Overviews 11.1, Gemini just 6.6.
findings.say: First, Profound measured AI Mode at 15.2 citations per run, against 11.1 for AI Overviews and 6.6 for the Gemini app.

findings.label: CLICKS
findings.headline: Fewer clicks to outside sites for people using AI Mode
findings.detail: Academic study reported by Babel42: AI Mode group compared with people using normal Google.
findings.evidence: clicked through to an outside website 18.8 percentage points less often than people using Google normally
findings.say: Second, a study found people assigned to AI Mode clicked out to websites 18.8 percentage points less often than on normal Google.

findings.label: ADOPTION
findings.headline: Monthly users of AI Mode, with queries 3× longer than search
findings.detail: Google's own figures, reported by PPC Land. The users figure dates from May 2026.
findings.evidence: AI Mode passed one billion monthly users in May
findings.say: Third, AI Mode passed one billion monthly users in May, and PPC Land reports its queries run three times longer than classic search.

take.headline: Cited is not the same as visited.
take.say: My take: more citations don't mean more visits. Track citations and clicks separately, then decide where your content effort actually goes.

sources.title: Profound: Variability of Google models, Gemini vs AIO vs AI Mode
Babel42: Google's AI Mode cuts referral traffic, a new study finds
PPC Land: Google Search gains Gemini 4 Hydrogen for all users

caption:
This morning: Google upgraded Search with Gemini 4 so AI Mode answers harder questions, and I asked whether it cites you.

Three new data points. Profound: AI Mode cites 15.2 sources per run, vs 11.1 for AI Overviews. A study: 18.8 points fewer clicks to outside sites in AI Mode. PPC Land: 1 billion monthly users, with queries 3x longer.

My take: more citations don't mean more visits. Measure citations and clicks separately.

Comment GEO and I will send you the details by DM.
